name: /quiet without arguments shows current and usage

payload.text:
Current quiet hours: 22:00–08:00

To set quiet hours, type:
/quiet 22 08

This suppresses alerts from 22:00 to 08:00.
Please enter hours as numbers between 0 and 23.

name: /quiet with valid hours sets quiet hours

payload.text: Quiet hours set: 23:00–07:00. Alerts will be suppressed during this window.
